cases.context:
Many more examples – an extensive collection of completions for most of
the common GNU, Unix, and Linux commands – are available as part of the
bash_completion project.  This is installed by default on many GNU/Linux
distributions.  Originally written by Ian Macdonald, the project now lives
at https://github.com/scop/bash-completion/.  There are ports for
other systems such as Solaris and Mac OS X.
cases.minimal_purpose: 일반 GNU/Unix/Linux 명령에 대한 programmable completion 예제 모음을 찾아 읽는다.

cases.context:
The 2018 POSIX standard is accessible online at
https://pubs.opengroup.org/onlinepubs/9699919799/.
cases.minimal_purpose: Preface 각주가 명시한 2018 POSIX standard를 읽는다.

cases.context:
The ‘|&’ operator for use in
communicating with a coprocess is described in
Two-way Communications With Another Process in GAWK: Effective AWK Programming.
It shows how to do two-way I/O to a
separate process, sending it data with print or printf and
reading data with getline.  If you haven’t read it already, you should
detour there to do so.
cases.minimal_purpose: gawk networking을 읽기 전에 coprocess에 print/printf로 보내고 getline으로 받는 양방향 I/O를 이해한다.

cases.context:
With the GNU C compiler, you may wish to use the ‘-MM’ flag instead
of ‘-M’.  This omits prerequisites on system header files.
See Options Controlling the Preprocessor in Using GNU CC, for details.
cases.minimal_purpose: 자동 prerequisites를 만들 때 GCC -M 대신 -MM을 쓰면 system header를 제외하는 이유와 옵션 상세를 읽는다.

cases.context:
Where is the newest gettext source?

The newest gettext release is available on ftp.gnu.org and its mirrors, in
https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/gettext/.
cases.minimal_purpose: GNU gettext의 newest stable source release가 배포되는 위치를 찾는다.
